employees.tempPasswordHint: Hand this password to the employee. It cannot be recovered after you close this page.
employees.allocHint: Leave this employee already has on day one, credited once. For a new hire this is normally 0 — the monthly accrual below builds the balance up. Use it to carry a balance over from the paper records. It is added on top of accrual and is not limited by the yearly cap below.
employees.allocWarn: Employee created, but setting leave balance failed:
employees.policyHint: What this employee earns each month, added to their current balance. Accrual starts from the current Jalali month — not the hire date — so someone added mid-year earns only the remaining months of that year.
employees.policyAnnualCapHint: The most that can be earned in one Jalali year — the employee's annual entitlement. 0 means no cap. Only monthly accrual counts toward it; balances set by hand do not.
employees.policyCarryCapHint: The most that survives into the next Jalali year. At Nowruz anything above this is forfeited. 0 means unused leave is lost each year.
employees.policyWarn: Employee created, but saving the accrual policy failed:
employees.defaultQuotaHint: Default leave quotas are assigned to the new employee automatically.

import.templateHint: Filled example (do not enter these rows). The supervisor column is the person's direct supervisor; the manager column is their department manager. Remaining leave is in days and hours, and may be negative:

modes.title: Import mode
modes.addHint: Create the people who are not in the app yet. A personnel number that already exists is an error. Nothing else changes.
modes.updateHint: Also update people already in the app (name, title, department, supervisor/manager, manager role). The file overwrites the names and manager of every department it uses. Nobody else is touched.
modes.replace: Replace — the file is the new source of truth
modes.replaceHint: Add & update, plus: people not in the file are deactivated or kept (you choose), and unused empty departments are deleted. Admin accounts are never touched.
modes.overwriteBalancesHint: Set each updated person's annual balance to the file's value as of the balance date. Leave recorded in the app after that date is not re-counted.
modes.replaceConfirmBody: {create} will be created, {update} updated, {deactivate} deactivated, and {deleteDepartments} empty departments deleted. This runs as one step; nothing changes if it fails.

role_assign.description: Give or remove read-only roles within your own access. Sensitive roles, HR and Finance are admin-only. HR holders can assign only Employee and Manager.

personal_info.label: Personal information
personal_info.description: Read: view and export. Allowed: correct and import.

clearance.label: Clearance forms
clearance.description: Read: every form. Allowed: file, edit, cancel; default rows.

departments.label: Departments
departments.description: Read: departments and members. Allowed: create, rename, set manager.

leave_balances.label: Leave balances
leave_balances.description: Read: anyone's balances and accrual policy. Allowed: opening balances, corrections, policy.

leave_accrual.label: Monthly accrual
leave_accrual.description: Post the monthly accrual for everyone.

leave_requests.label: Request archive
leave_requests.description: Read: every request with its reason and signatures, and print. Allowed: the right to cancel someone else's request (no screen offers it yet).

approval_steps.label: Approval steps
approval_steps.description: Read: view the steps. Allowed: add, remove, reorder, turn on and off, and decide whether their order binds.

work_settings.label: Work week
work_settings.description: Weekly days off, working hours, hourly cap.

holidays.label: Official holidays
holidays.description: Add, edit, delete and upload holidays.

approval_delegate.label: Approval delegation
approval_delegate.description: Choose your own approval delegate. This does not grant role editing or access to other people’s delegation settings.

levels.noRead: This item has no read-only level
levels.noEdit: This item can only be viewed

rolesAdmin.sensitiveDescription: These permissions can change employee data, balances, access or company settings. They may have unintended consequences, especially when combined with other roles. Only the admin can assign roles with this access. Review the permissions below before saving. Changes to an existing role affect everyone who holds it.
rolesAdmin.title: Roles
rolesAdmin.intro: Who can do what. A role covers the whole company, but never its holder's own record or the admin.
rolesAdmin.holders: {count, plural, =0 {No one} one {# person} other {# people}}
rolesAdmin.adminRow: Full access. Exactly one person holds it.
rolesAdmin.nameInvalid: Use English letters, digits, space, & / or -, start with a letter or digit, at most 40 characters.
rolesAdmin.nameLocked: A built-in role keeps its name.
rolesAdmin.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?

adminOnly.title: Admin only
adminOnly.intro: No role can hold these. They stay with the admin.

items.passwordReset: Reset passwords and issue new login slips
items.approvalOverride: Fill any approval step, and sign their own request
items.bulkImport: Bulk import in Update and Replace modes
items.identity: Change a personnel number, employee code or company

delete.title: Delete the role <role>{name}</role>?
delete.body: {count, plural, =0 {No one holds this role.} one {# person holds this role. They lose it.} other {# people hold this role. They all lose it.}}
delete.inactive: {count, plural, one {# of them is inactive.} other {# of them are inactive.}}
delete.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the numbers by hand.

transfer.title: Transfer admin
transfer.intro: Hand full access to another active employee.
transfer.personnelNo: Type their personnel number to confirm (their employee code if they have none)
transfer.warning: You will lose admin. Only the new admin can give it back.
transfer.loadFailed: Could not load the employee list.

rolesDelegation.title: Approval delegates
rolesDelegation.permissionRequired: This person needs approval duties and Approval delegation set to Yes. The admin can assign a supplementary custom role; the built-in Manager role stays locked.
rolesDelegation.hint: Choose who may sign approvals on behalf of the selected approver. This does not change anyone’s role or personnel access.
rolesDelegation.fallback: After the absence, the eligible saved delegate resumes: {name}.
rolesDelegation.eligibility: Candidates must be active managers or existing approvers in this company. You cannot select yourself.
rolesDelegation.ceoEligibility: The CEO’s delegate must already directly report to the designated CEO and be an eligible approver.
rolesDelegation.ceoAttestation: I confirm that I am authorized by the CEO to make this appointment and authorize automatic approval of the CEO step on this delegate’s own requests when they submit them. This does not waive other required approvals.
rolesDelegation.retainedAuthority: The original approver keeps authority. A delegate cannot use this appointment to sign their own request. Temporary eligible cover takes precedence only during the approved absence.
rolesDelegation.executiveHint: Designate the CEO and HR head explicitly. The server validates natural approval authority and applicable steps before activating the policy. Changes may invalidate pending timers.
rolesDelegation.hrStepsHint: Select only genuine HR review steps. The designated HR head is exempt from these steps on their own requests. Other named approvers remain required.
rolesDelegation.noSteps: No approval steps are available. Configure the approval chain first.

delegation.title: Approval coverage and authorization
delegation.previewFailed: Approval coverage could not be checked. Refresh the preview before submitting.
delegation.previewRequired: Refresh the approval coverage preview before submitting.
delegation.bounds: Delegation window: {start} to {end}, ending exclusively (Tehran time).
delegation.replacementHint: Choose work cover from your department or an eligible approval delegate from across the company.
delegation.temporary: {name} will be your temporary approval delegate during this absence.
delegation.temporaryConditions: Authority starts only after the absence is approved and its start time is reached, and ends at the displayed end. This appointment cannot be used to approve the absence that creates it.
delegation.savedResumes: After the absence, your eligible saved delegate resumes: {name}.
delegation.noSavedFallback: There is no saved fallback delegate. After this absence, you remain responsible for approvals.
delegation.savedContinues: Your saved approval delegate, {name}, will continue to handle approvals.
delegation.workCoverFallback: Your replacement covers work only and cannot sign approvals on your behalf. Your saved approval delegate, {name}, will continue to handle approvals.
delegation.noDelegateWarning: You have no approval delegate or replacement. If a request requires your approval while you are away, you must respond yourself or select a replacement/delegate now.
delegation.workCoverWarning: Your replacement covers work only and cannot sign approvals on your behalf. You have no approval delegate, so you must respond to approval requests yourself or arrange a delegate.
delegation.contactAdmin: Contact the admin to arrange an approval delegate. You can still submit this request.
delegation.autoPolicy: Because you are the CEO’s appointed delegate, the CEO approval step on this request is approved automatically when you submit it, under the recorded CEO authorization. Other required approvals still apply.
delegation.ownConsent: I accept responsibility for this request. Under the CEO’s explicit authorization recorded in the system, the CEO approval step will be completed automatically when I submit it. Any other required approval steps still apply.
delegation.ownConsentRequired: Accept responsibility for this request and the recorded CEO automatic approval policy before submitting.
delegation.temporaryCeoAuthorization: I explicitly authorize {name} as my temporary CEO delegate during the approved absence. While the appointment is in effect, the CEO step on their own eligible requests is approved automatically when they submit them. Other required approvals still apply.
delegation.temporaryConsentRequired: Explicit CEO authorization for this temporary delegate is required before submitting.

approvalEvidence.hrExempt: Not required — request submitted by the Head of HR
approvalEvidence.automaticStatement: Automatically approved under explicit authority from CEO {principal}. The requester accepted responsibility for this automatic approval. This is not the CEO’s handwritten signature.
approvalEvidence.configurationChanged: The approval chain has changed since submission. The current required steps are shown below.
approvalEvidence.legacyReconciliation: Older approval evidence cannot identify the required steps unambiguously. The remaining steps need explicit decisions; contact the admin if clarification is needed.
approvalEvidence.historicalHrExemption: HR review was not required when submitted. This step has since changed and now requires review.
